hints.title: Unmatched Counter Tracking Obstacle
hints.text: Matching each bracket requires counting complementary partners. How can two numeric counters track unmatched opening and closing symbols simultaneously in a single pass without auxiliary storage?

hints.title: Independent Imbalance Invariant
hints.text: Every closing bracket without an available preceding opening bracket must be inserted, and any opening brackets left unmatched at the end must each be closed.

hints.title: Two-Counter Balance Procedure
hints.text: Initialize open_count and additions to 0. Traverse each character: on '(', increment open_count. On ')', if open_count > 0, decrement open_count; otherwise increment additions. At the end, return additions + open_count.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of string s (1 <= N <= 1000)
complexity.notes: Single pass with two scalar balance counters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating insertions or keeping arrays of characters uses unnecessary O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scalar counters achieve optimal O(1) space and strictly O(N) runtime.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizing that unmatched '(' and unmatched ')' can be tallied independently.
